The Sicilian Defence is the opening this fixture stands in for, and every sentence of it is written for the test rather than taken from the page it imitates.

What the parser has to survive is the shape of the document, not what it says: a first paragraph, a blank line, more prose, a separator line, then a footer that must not reach the index. These lines reproduce that shape, and they are long enough to clear the threshold under which an article is dropped as undocumented.

The last thing exercised here is the decoding of the entities the page is written with, so this sentence mentions Black's c-pawn and stops there.
